components.name: Module Panel
components.description: Represents one logical ZOIA module; authored effect panels can be dragged into another Signal Chain gap.
components.css: .ds-module{width:188px;height:92px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 0;border:1px solid #425847;border-radius:5px;background:#111813;color:#dce8da;box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.46)}.ds-module i{width:7px;height:17px;border:1px solid #75bd87;border-radius:2px;background:#0a100c}.ds-module small{color:#8eac91;font:500 .56rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}.ds-module div{display:grid;gap:5px;flex:1}.ds-module strong{font:.86rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}.ds-module span{color:#8eac91;font:.68rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}

components.name: Patch Document Control Rail
components.description: Keeps history, insertion, explicit endpoint routing, Module selection, validation, portable JSON saving, and binary export in one compact instrument rail.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px;border:1px solid #344b39;border-radius:5px;background:#0d140f;color:#dce8da;font:600 .64rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-rail button,.ds-rail select{height:34px;border:1px solid #405347;border-radius:4px;background:#151e17;color:#a7ffc2}.ds-rail button:focus-visible,.ds-rail select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7ffc2;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Raw Parameter Control
components.description: Pairs continuous exploration with exact unsigned 16-bit entry.
components.css: .ds-parameter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 82px;gap:10px;color:#dce8da;font:.72rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}.ds-parameter span{grid-column:1/-1}.ds-parameter input[type=range]{accent-color:#78f0a3}.ds-parameter input[type=number]{height:30px;padding:0 7px;border:1px solid #415347;border-radius:4px;background:#090f0b;color:#a7ffc2;font:.67rem ui-monospace,monospace;text-align:right}.ds-parameter input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7ffc2;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Module Library
components.description: Shows one row per Module family with compact buttons for each configured option variant.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-library{width:380px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #506354;border-radius:8px;background:#101713;color:#dce8da;box-shadow:-14px 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.64);font:.72rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}.ds-library header{display:grid;gap:4px;margin-bottom:14px}.ds-library header strong{font-size:1.06rem}.ds-library header small{color:#849688}.ds-library input{width:100%;height:34px;margin-bottom:10px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid #46594b;border-radius:4px;background:#0a100c;color:#dce8da}.ds-library article{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr 74px;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #2d3a31}.ds-library article>span,.ds-library article>div{display:grid;gap:5px}.ds-library article small,.ds-library article p{margin:0;color:#769079;font-size:.58rem}.ds-library button{min-height:28px;border:1px solid #46604d;border-radius:4px;background:#111b14;color:#a7ffc2}.ds-library :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7ffc2;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Validation Finding
components.description: Floats current validation feedback above the bottom-center canvas without changing workspace geometry.
components.css: .ds-validation{width:620px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:start;gap:14px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #72522c;border-radius:5px;background:#1d170e;color:#d4bb91;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.46);font:.7rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}.ds-validation strong{color:#e8a94b;font:600 .58rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}.ds-validation button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#b79c76}.ds-validation button:hover{color:#f0d3a8}.ds-validation button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7ffc2;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Editable Signal Connection
components.description: Reveals direct insertion at the midpoint while preserving a quiet resting signal trace.

narrative.overview: ZOIA / SCOPE behaves like calibrated studio test equipment rather than a generic developer graph. The graph is the observed signal; physical references remain abstracted into useful hierarchy rather than fake machinery.
keyCharacteristics: Phosphor reserved for live routing and action
Compact instrument labels with readable body text

rules.name: The Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Bright green identifies something actionable, selected, or carrying signal; inactive structure stays graphite.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace earns its place only for readings, IDs, endpoints, statuses, or controls.

rules.name: The Housing Rule
rules.body: Surfaces use structural depth and never become soft floating cards.

dos: Use green as semantic signal state.
Retain pan, zoom, fit-view, focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not reproduce the LED grid as the organizing model.
Do not add fake knobs or ornamental controls.
Do not shrink mobile graph labels into illegibility.
